title: Resolve, Directing the Department of Transportation to Study the Feasibility of Ferry Service to Monhegan Island

summary.text: This resolve directs the Department of Transportation to work with island and ferry service stakeholders to study the feasibility of adding ferry service to Monhegan Island. The department must submit a report by December 3, 2025 to the Joint Standing Committee on Transportation, which is authorized to submit legislation to the Second Regular Session of the 132nd Legislature.
